mainText: <speak><voice name="Ivy">Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at a clear and pleasant day with the temperature at 82 degrees near the Verona Public Library, while the full moon continues to light up our skies.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">The City Clerk's office has launched a contest for students to design new I Voted stickers for our elections. There are four categories ranging from kindergarten to high school, and community voting is now officially open online through August 7 to help decide which designs will be used this November.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">We have plenty of fun ahead. Today you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the downtown Farmers Market returns to Hometown Junction Park, alongside Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory and more music at Paddy Mac's.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kimberly">In a report covering July 20 through July 27, officers responded to several calls, including an incident on July 25 where a driver was arrested for an O W I offence.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Matthew">Make sure to stop by Culver's to enjoy today's delicious Georgia Peach flavor. They are currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight.</voice></speak>
